purpose: Train one sales-only residual boosting model on FreshRetailNet development records and transfer its fixed learned weights to previously unscored UCI country groups. No target-domain fitting or tuning.
priorKnowledge: FreshRetailNet v1/v2 outcomes and UCI Ridge outcomes for EIRE, France, Germany and United Kingdom are known. UCI calendar conditions and publisher records have been available. This is a prespecified test on previously unscored groups, not a fully blind calendar/domain replication.

source.development: Exactly the previous 500 ID-selected series and publisher train split only, through 2024-06-25. Publisher eval records are not read for fitting or selection.

target.selection: Every other country with at least 20 positive-sales dates, at least 1000 gross units and positive first-84-day mean within 2010-12-02 through 2011-10-31. Thresholds use context dates only; do not relax if no countries qualify. Unspecified remains excluded by the original aggregation protocol.
target.observations: Reuse the locked UCI invoice filtering/calendar event-SUM definition. Use raw positive invoiced units directly for inference; do not train or fit a target normalization/scaler. Earlier observed dates provide context only.
target.test: 19 non-overlapping two-day targets per selected country from 2011-11-01 through 2011-12-08. Earlier actual target-domain test days may enter later lags; the learned model never refits.

features.policy: 14 past quantity lags divided by mean14 (floor 1e-6); relative mean3/7, median7, std7, trend7, zero fraction7, prior-week two-day total. Calendar variant adds weekday sin/cos and known upcoming weekend-day count.
removed: past stockout fraction: not observed in UCI, never fabricated as zero
log absolute sales level: source/target sales units differ
features.compatibility: A new feature-compatible model is trained. Original v2 artifact has required stockout features and is not directly applied to UCI. Relative features aim for multiplicative scale equivariance above the numerical floor; this does not establish domain invariance.

selection: Source-only validation MAE: train origins 14,16,...,74; validate 76,78,...,88 on each 90-day FreshRetailNet series. Four tree configurations times four residual weights. Tie-break lower weight, fewer leaves, lags. Weight zero retains MA7. Refit selected tree configuration on source origins 14,16,...,88 only.
freezing: Save protocol/source hashes, all validation scores, selected parameters, learned joblib artifact and checksum before parsing target workbook or scoring target records. Save all selected groups/targets; any pipeline failure fails the run. No retuning after scores.
primaryMetric: Equal-country mean WAPE on the new UCI groups. Report undefined-zero-target country count; retain those countries in pooled MAE/WAPE and all predictions.
secondaryMetrics: Pooled raw-unit MAE/WAPE, per-country MAE/WAPE, per-origin scores, target volume shares and count of countries beating each baseline. No numeric comparison against older different samples as if paired.
limitations: Known UCI calendar, one gift/wholesale retailer, correlated country groups and sparse event totals. Only a new sales-only boosting variant's fixed weights are transferred. No claim about original v2 weights, latent demand, ingredient usage, Indonesian field performance, calibrated uncertainty, public-model activation or Qwen fine-tuning. Repetition after this first score is reproducibility, not independent evaluation.
